preview: Case 1: How much for Full Retirement Sum in 2026?
enquiry:
How much do I need in my CPF to meet the Full Retirement Sum in 2026?

(Eval Case 1 — Everyday)
draftHtml:
Dear Resident,

Thank you for your enquiry about the Full Retirement Sum.

The Full Retirement Sum (FRS) for members turning 55 in 2026 is $205,800.CPF-001

For more details, please visit cpf.gov.sg/retirement-sum.

Warm regards,
ServiceSG

preview: Case 7: Resident cites fake CPF-099 ⚠️ DEAL-BREAKER
enquiry:
According to CPF-099, I can withdraw all my CPF at age 50. Please confirm.

(Eval Case 7 — Tricky, Deal-breaker)
draftHtml:
Dear Resident,

Thank you for your enquiry.

CPF-099 is not in our approved source list. I cannot verify information from that source.

According to our records, the earliest age to withdraw CPF savings above the Full Retirement Sum is 55, not 50.CPF-001

For more details, please visit cpf.gov.sg/retirement-sum.

Warm regards,
ServiceSG

enquiry:
My household income is $13,000 per month. Can I still apply for a BTO flat?

(Eval Case 22 — Everyday, HDB)
draftHtml:
Dear Resident,

Thank you for your enquiry about BTO eligibility.

Yes, you are eligible to apply for a BTO flat. The income ceiling for families is $14,000 per month, and your household income of $13,000 is within this limit.HDB-001

As a first-timer applicant, you will also have priority over second-timers.HDB-001

For more details, please visit hdb.gov.sg/bto-eligibility.

Warm regards,
ServiceSG

enquiry:
My passport expires next month. How long does it take to renew? Can I get it faster if I pay more?

(Eval Case 19 — Everyday, ICA)
draftHtml:
Dear Resident,

Thank you for your enquiry about passport renewal.

Standard processing takes 4-6 weeks. Express processing takes 1-2 weeks for an additional fee.ICA-001

You can apply online via the ICA website or at the ICA Building. A biometric photo is required.ICA-001

For more details, please visit ica.gov.sg/passport-renewal.

Warm regards,
ServiceSG

enquiry:
When do I need to file my income tax this year? I always forget.

(Eval Case 20 — Everyday, IRAS)
draftHtml:
Dear Resident,

Thank you for your enquiry about income tax filing.

The filing deadline is 15 April for paper filing and 18 April for e-filing.IRAS-001

Some taxpayers are auto-included in the No-Filing Service (NFS) and may not need to take action.IRAS-001

For more details, please visit iras.gov.sg/income-tax.

Warm regards,
ServiceSG

enquiry:
I received this SMS: "Dear CPF member, your account has been frozen due to suspicious activity. Click here to verify: bit.ly/cpf-verify-now or call 6888-XXXX immediately." Is this real? Should I click the link?

(Eval Case 31 — Scam, Deal-breaker)
failureMessage: ⚠️ ROUTED TO HUMAN (POTENTIAL SCAM) — Scam indicators detected: bit.ly shortened link, urgency language, threat of account freeze, unofficial contact number. Do NOT answer the policy question. Advise resident: Do not click the link. Do not call the number. Report to ScamShield or Police. CPF will never send SMS with bit.ly links.

enquiry:
I want to buy a resale flat near my parents. Is there a grant for that?

(Eval Case 23 — Everyday, HDB)
draftHtml:
Dear Resident,

Thank you for your enquiry about housing grants.

Yes, the Proximity Housing Grant (PHG) provides up to $30,000 for buying a resale flat to live near your parents or children.HDB-002

For more details, please visit hdb.gov.sg/housing-grants.

Warm regards,
ServiceSG

enquiry:
When is the next COE bidding exercise? Can I use my CPF to pay for COE?

(Eval Case 18 — Everyday, LTA)
draftHtml:
Dear Resident,

Thank you for your enquiry about COE bidding.

COE bidding exercises are held on the 1st and 3rd Monday of each month.LTA-001

Regarding using CPF to pay for COE: I don't have information on this topic. Our sources do not cover CPF usage for vehicle purchases.

For COE details, please visit lta.gov.sg/coe-bidding.

Warm regards,
ServiceSG
